maddeler.e:
تعرقبتم (form IIq)
# تَعَرْقَبْتُمْ (taʕarqabtum) /ta.ʕar.qab.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# تُعُرْقِبْتُمْ (tuʕurqibtum) /tu.ʕur.qib.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
